title: Four-eye control on sensitive access grants; removals apply immediately
context: Research into enterprise treasury tools (Treasury Systems' 'four-eye control', Nomentia's approval workflow) shows two rules that must hold together: (a) increases to sensitive authority need an independent approval — a second admin must sign off; (b) removals apply immediately, no waiting on approval. Without (a) an admin can silently grant themselves financial authority. Without (b) an urgent revoke sits in a queue.
decision: Grants of ADMIN, CFO or COMPLIANCE_OFFICER go through a pending queue that another admin must approve. Grants of any other role, revocations of any role, and status/name/scope changes all apply immediately. Requester != reviewer is enforced server-side (SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES) — the reviewer cannot approve their own request even if they hold ADMIN.

shape.table: access_change_request { id, tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, change_type, payload_json, reason, status IN('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','WITHDRAWN'), requested_by, requested_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_reason }
shape.service: backend/app/services/access_change_service.py — is_sensitive, create_role_grant_request, list_pending, approve, reject; enforces requester != reviewer
endpoints: GET /admin/access-changes — list PENDING requests for the tenant
POST /admin/access-changes/{id}/approve — apply the change and stamp reviewer
POST /admin/access-changes/{id}/reject — refuse with a required reason
shape.PATCH_admin_users_behaviour: When body.roles adds a sensitive role, the sync creates a pending request instead of writing a Membership. Non-sensitive additions and any revocations apply the same call. Response reports both roles_applied and roles_pending_review in the audit payload.
shape.user_row: UserRow gains pending_role_grants: list[str] — the sensitive roles awaiting review for this user. Rendered as an amber 'Pending: CFO' chip in the Admin users table.

invariants: A user with pending sensitive grants signs in without those roles until a second admin approves. Their /auth/me returns the applied set only.
A reviewer cannot approve or reject their own request (server enforces via SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES).
Applying an APPROVED request is idempotent — if the grant already exists (another admin acted in parallel), the approval marks reviewed but doesn't duplicate the Membership.
Revocations always apply immediately — even of sensitive roles. There is no queue for removal.

admins: l.price (ADMIN only — seeded so the demo has two admins for a proper four-eye flow)

future_work: Scope-widening (e.g. granting group-wide access to a previously scoped user) should join the four-eye queue.
'Withdraw my request' action for the requester on their own pending row.
Configurable list of sensitive roles per tenant (currently a hard-coded set).
consequences: backend/app/api/admin_users.py — _sync_roles queues sensitive grants; UserRow includes pending_role_grants; new /admin/access-changes endpoints
backend/app/seed_data.py — usr_price added as a second admin
frontend/app/admin/page.tsx — AccessChangesCard queue + amber 'Pending: {role}' chip on user rows + RoleChangePreview warns before Save
